About Me

About Me

I am Arfan Ahmed, a senior Full-Stack Developer & WordPress Architect specializing in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and custom WordPress engine architecture.

My career began at the Centre for Data Science Research (CDSR) building data-intensive MERN applications. Currently at Exprovia, I engineer high-speed enterprise frontends, custom WooCommerce plugins, and headless CMS integrations.

I focus on writing clean, fully-typed code that drives real business growth, achieves top Lighthouse performance, and scales reliably long-term.

Personal Story & Motivation

Driven by Curiosity, Powered by Code

My journey into software engineering started with a simple question: “How do complex web applications deliver instant, seamless experiences to millions of users?”As a Computer Science & Engineering student at Patuakhali Science and Technology University (PSTU), I began exploring C/C++, algorithms, and backend architectures.

What began as academic curiosity quickly transformed into a lifelong passion for full-stack engineering and custom WordPress ecosystem design. I thrive on bridging technical complexity with intuitive user interfaces — whether architecting 100% type-safe REST APIs, writing custom WordPress sync plugins from scratch, or building Next.js applications optimized for zero hydration latency.

My core philosophy centers on relentless craftsmanship, continuous learning, and measurable business impact. Software is not just about writing code; it's about creating resilient digital assets that empower real businesses to grow.

Continuous Learning

Constantly mastering Next.js 15, TypeScript, and modern headless CMS architecture.
